_note: Sign / symptom / history finding -> diagnosis: likelihood ratios transcribed from the ABSTRACTS of published diagnostic-accuracy reviews (PubMed; PMID is the trace). Only the numbers are kept here -- the abstracts are the publishers' text and stay in cache/pubmed/ (git-ignored); scripts/verify_diagnostic_accuracy.py checks that every number in `as_written` appears in the cached abstract. `when` is present (LR if the finding is present) or absent (LR if absent); a present finding may LOWER the odds (history of vaginal discharge, LR 0.3, for UTI). Where the abstract gives only pooled sensitivity and specificity, build_edges.py derives LR+ = sens/(1-spec) and LR- = (1-sens)/spec and marks the edge derived; no interval is invented for a derived LR. `finding_terms` / `diagnosis_terms` are the SNOMED CT-AU terms tried, exact match only, on the live Ontoserver (scripts/bind_diagnostic_accuracy.py); the terms are chosen by the transcriber, so each is a proposal and never a near-synonym fallback that would merge findings the source keeps apart (calf swelling vs a difference in calf diameter; vaginal discharge reported vs seen); a record whose finding or diagnosis does not bind exactly stays here as a candidate, never an edge. Reviews whose abstracts give only ranges across several findings (Aalbers 2011 pharyngitis, Swap 2005 chest pain, Andersson 2004 appendicitis) or no per-finding numbers (Metlay 1997 pneumonia; Williams 1992 ascites has no abstract) contributed nothing. Transcribed 23 Sep 2026; every edge is corrected_pending_attestation.
